name: xslt-tester
description: Test XSLT 1.0 and XSLT 2.0 transformations: provide XML input and an XSLT stylesheet, see the result instantly. Dual engines: bundled Saxon-JS (© Saxonica Ltd, distributed under the Saxonica license — see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and native libxslt (xsltproc) with EXSLT support.

commands.title: XSLT Tester: Run Transformation (pick XML + XSLT files)
XSLT Tester: Run Transformation with Active File

enumDescriptions: XSLT 1.0 stylesheets use libxslt (when xsltproc is installed) for authentic 1.0/EXSLT semantics; XSLT 2.0+ uses Saxon-JS.
Always use the bundled Saxon-JS processor (XSLT 3.0; runs 2.0 natively, 1.0 in backwards-compatible mode).
Always use libxslt via the xsltproc executable (XSLT 1.0 + EXSLT only).
xsltTester.engine.description: Which XSLT engine to use for transformations.

xsltTester.xsltprocPath.description: Full path to the xsltproc executable (libxslt). Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH and common install locations.

xsltTester.extraXsltprocArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to xsltproc (e.g. ["--nonet"], ["--timing"]).

xsltTester.outputTarget.description: Where to show transformation results for file-based runs: a new editor tab, or a file written next to the XML input.

xsltTester.extraSaxonArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to the Saxon-JS xslt3 processor (e.g. ["-t"] for timing info).

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run clean && esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --external:vscode --platform=node --target=node16 --outfile=out/extension.js --minify && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/saxon-worker.js','out/saxon-worker.js')"
